mentions.name: Puddle Watercolor
mentions.description: A digital watercolor painting app that models the real-world physics of paper, brush bristles, pigments, water, color mixing, and drying in real time on the GPU, aiming for results that look and feel like real watercolor. Built in Rust with wgpu; runs on iPad with Apple Pencil or finger support.
mentions.audience: iPad users painting with Apple Pencil or finger (currently seeking beta testers)
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m making a digital real watercolor kit.

I’m a software developer and watercolor painter so my goal is to use real world painting techniques and have the results feel and look real.

Modeling the physics of paper, brush bristles, pigments, water, color mixing, drying in real time using gpu.
